lesson: Liouville closes because mu*liou = 1 puts L(x, psi) in the numerator of each dual-frequency series, so a second moment on Re x = 1/2 + eps bounds the remainder. Every other unimodular multiplicative weight, THIN included, has 1/L there and needs a zero-free half-plane for the whole twist family. The coherent term itself is a weight-blind Hermitian form, so this half carries no R1. Taking Re z = 1 + eps in the row Mellin variable makes the frequency sum absolutely convergent and removes c7's truncation losses.
